items.text:
अमेध्यरेतो गोमांसं चण्डालान्नं अथापि वा ।
यदि भुक्तं तु विप्रेण कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं चरेत् ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
amedhyareto gomāṃsaṃ caṇḍālānnaṃ athāpi vā |
yadi bhuktaṃ tu vipreṇa kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret || 1 ||
items.en: If a Brahmin eats something impure, semen, beef, or food from a Cāṇḍāla, he should perform the Kṛcchra and the Cāndrāyaṇa.
items.note: Kṛcchra: a penance of controlled eating and fasting over several days. Cāndrāyaṇa: a month-long penance where food is reduced and increased by one mouthful a day with the phases of the moon. Cāṇḍāla: a person of the lowest, 'untouchable' group.

items.text:
तथैव क्षत्रियो वैश्योऽप्यर्धं चान्द्रायणं चरेत् ।
शूद्रोऽप्येवं यदा भुङ्क्ते प्राजापत्यं समाचरेत् ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
tathaiva kṣatriyo vaiśyo'pyardhaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |
śūdro'pyevaṃ yadā bhuṅkte prājāpatyaṃ samācaret || 2 ||
items.en: In the same case a Kṣatriya or a Vaiśya should perform half a Cāndrāyaṇa. When a Śūdra eats such things, he should perform the Prājāpatya.
items.note: Prājāpatya: a twelve-day Kṛcchra penance (three days eating once in the morning, three in the evening, three days of unasked food, three days of fasting).

items.text:
पञ्चगव्यं पिबेच्छूद्रो ब्रह्मकूर्चं पिबेद्द्विजः ।
एकद्वित्रिचतुर्गा वा दद्याद्विप्राद्यनुक्रमात् ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
pañcagavyaṃ pibecchūdro brahmakūrcaṃ pibeddvijaḥ |
ekadvitricaturgā vā dadyādviprādyanukramāt || 3 ||
items.en: The Śūdra should drink pañcagavya; the twice-born should drink brahmakūrca. Or they may give one, two, three or four cows, in order starting with the Brahmin.
items.note: pañcagavya: a mixture of five cow products (urine, dung, milk, curd, ghee). brahmakūrca: pañcagavya consecrated with mantras and offered in fire before drinking (described in 11.28-11.39). The text does not make clear which caste gives how many cows.

items.text:
शूद्रान्नं सूतकान्नं च अभोज्यस्यान्नं एव च ।
शङ्कितं प्रतिषिद्धान्नं पूर्वोच्छिष्टं तथैव च ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
śūdrānnaṃ sūtakānnaṃ ca abhojyasyānnaṃ eva ca |
śaṅkitaṃ pratiṣiddhānnaṃ pūrvocchiṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca || 4 ||
items.en: Food of a Śūdra, food from a house under sūtaka, food of a person whose food must not be eaten, food that is doubtful, forbidden food, and food already left over by another person —
items.note: sūtaka: the period of ritual impurity in a family after a birth (or death).

items.text:
यदि भुक्तं तु विप्रेण अज्ञानादापदापि वा ।
ज्ञात्वा समाचरेत्कृच्छ्रं ब्रह्मकूर्चं तु पावनम् ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
yadi bhuktaṃ tu vipreṇa ajñānādāpadāpi vā |
jñātvā samācaretkṛcchraṃ brahmakūrcaṃ tu pāvanam || 5 ||
items.en: … if a Brahmin eats any of these unknowingly or in an emergency, then on learning of it he should perform a Kṛcchra; the brahmakūrca also purifies.

items.text:
बालैर्नकुलमार्जारैरन्नं उच्छिष्टितं यदा ।
तिलदर्भोदकैः प्रोक्ष्य शुध्यते नात्रसंशयः ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
bālairnakulamārjārairannaṃ ucchiṣṭitaṃ yadā |
tiladarbhodakaiḥ prokṣya śudhyate nātrasaṃśayaḥ || 6 ||
items.en: When food has been made impure as leftovers by children, mongooses or cats, it becomes pure by sprinkling it with water mixed with sesame and darbha grass. There is no doubt about this.
items.note: darbha: a sacred grass (kuśa) used in rituals.

items.text:
एकपङ्क्त्युपविष्टानां विप्राणां सह भोजने ।
यद्येकोऽपि त्यजेत्पात्रं शेषं अन्नं न भोजयेत् ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
ekapaṅktyupaviṣṭānāṃ viprāṇāṃ saha bhojane |
yadyeko'pi tyajetpātraṃ śeṣaṃ annaṃ na bhojayet || 7 ||
items.en: When Brahmins sit in one row and eat together, if even one of them leaves his plate, the others should not eat the remaining food.

items.text:
मोहाद्भुञ्जीत यस्तत्र पङ्क्तावुच्छिष्टभोजने ।
प्रायश्चित्तं चरेद्विप्रः कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं तथा ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
mohādbhuñjīta yastatra paṅktāvucchiṣṭabhojane |
prāyaścittaṃ caredvipraḥ kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ tathā || 8 ||
items.en: A Brahmin who out of confusion goes on eating in that row, eating what has become leftover food, should perform the Kṛcchra Sāntapana as penance.
items.note: Sāntapana: a Kṛcchra penance in which one lives on pañcagavya and kuśa water for a day and then fasts for a day (longer forms exist).

items.text:
पीयूषं श्वेतलशुनं वृन्ताकफलगृञ्जने ।
पलाण्डुवृक्षनिर्यास देवस्वकवकानि च ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
pīyūṣaṃ śvetalaśunaṃ vṛntākaphalagṛñjane |
palāṇḍuvṛkṣaniryāsa devasvakavakāni ca || 9 ||
items.en: Beestings, white garlic, eggplant, gṛñjana, onion, resin from trees, property belonging to the gods, mushrooms,
items.note: Beestings: the first thick milk of a cow after calving. gṛñjana: a kind of red garlic or carrot-like root. This sentence continues in the next verse.

items.text:
उष्ट्रीक्षीरं अविक्षीरं अज्ञानाद्भुञ्जते द्विजः ।
त्रिरात्रं उपवासेन पञ्चगव्येन शुध्यति ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
uṣṭrīkṣīraṃ avikṣīraṃ ajñānādbhuñjate dvijaḥ |
trirātraṃ upavāsena pañcagavyena śudhyati || 10 ||
items.en: … camel's milk and sheep's milk — if a twice-born eats these unknowingly, he is purified by fasting for three nights and taking pañcagavya.

items.text:
मण्डूकं भक्षयित्वा तु मूषिकामांसं एव च ।
ज्ञात्वा विप्रस्त्वहोरात्रं यावकान्नेन शुध्यति ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
maṇḍūkaṃ bhakṣayitvā tu mūṣikāmāṃsaṃ eva ca |
jñātvā viprastvahorātraṃ yāvakānnena śudhyati || 11 ||
items.en: A Brahmin who knowingly eats a frog or the meat of a rat is purified by living for a day and a night on yāvaka.
items.note: yāvaka: a simple dish of boiled barley, eaten as a penance food.

items.text:
क्षत्रियश्चापि वैश्यश्च क्रियावन्तौ शुचिव्रतौ ।
तद्गृहे तु द्विजैर्भोज्यं हव्यकव्येषु नित्यशः ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
kṣatriyaścāpi vaiśyaśca kriyāvantau śucivratau |
tadgṛhe tu dvijairbhojyaṃ havyakavyeṣu nityaśaḥ || 12 ||
items.en: Kṣatriyas and Vaiśyas who perform their rites and keep pure vows — food in their houses may always be eaten by the twice-born, including at offerings to the gods and the ancestors.

items.text:
घृतं तैलं तथा क्षीरं भक्ष्यं स्नेहेन पाचितम् ।
गत्वा नदीतटे विप्रो भुञ्जीयाच्छूद्रभोजनं ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ tathā kṣīraṃ bhakṣyaṃ snehena pācitam |
gatvā nadītaṭe vipro bhuñjīyācchūdrabhojanaṃ || 13 ||
items.en: Ghee, oil, milk, and food cooked in fat — a Brahmin may eat such food of a Śūdra after going to the bank of a river.

items.text:
मद्यमांसरतं नित्यं नीचकर्मप्रवर्तकम् ।
तं शूद्रं वर्जयेद्विप्रः श्वपाकं इव दूरतः ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
madyamāṃsarataṃ nityaṃ nīcakarmapravartakam |
taṃ śūdraṃ varjayedvipraḥ śvapākaṃ iva dūrataḥ || 14 ||
items.en: A Śūdra who is always fond of liquor and meat and who does low work — a Brahmin should keep far away from him, as from a dog-eater.
items.note: Dog-eater (śvapāka): a person of the lowest outcaste group.

items.text:
द्विजशुश्रूषणरतान्मद्यमांसविवर्जितान् ।
स्वकर्मणि रतान्नित्यं न तान्शूद्रान्त्यजेद्द्विजः ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
dvijaśuśrūṣaṇaratānmadyamāṃsavivarjitān |
svakarmaṇi ratānnityaṃ na tānśūdrāntyajeddvijaḥ || 15 ||
items.en: Śūdras who are devoted to serving the twice-born, who avoid liquor and meat, and who always keep to their own duties — the twice-born should not shun them.

items.text:
अज्ञानाद्भुञ्जते विप्राः सूतके मृतकेऽपि वा ।
प्रायश्चित्तं कथं तेषां वर्णे वर्णे विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
ajñānādbhuñjate viprāḥ sūtake mṛtake'pi vā |
prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ varṇe varṇe vinirdiśet || 16 ||
items.en: If Brahmins unknowingly eat food during the impurity after a birth or a death, how should the penance be fixed for them, for each varṇa?
items.note: varṇa: one of the four social classes (Brahmin, Kṣatriya, Vaiśya, Śūdra).

items.text:
गायत्र्यष्टसहस्रेण शुद्धिः स्याच्छूद्रसूतके ।
वैश्ये पञ्चसहस्रेण त्रिसहस्रेण क्षत्रिये ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
gāyatryaṣṭasahasreṇa śuddhiḥ syācchūdrasūtake |
vaiśye pañcasahasreṇa trisahasreṇa kṣatriye || 17 ||
items.en: Purification comes from reciting the Gāyatrī eight thousand times for food eaten in a Śūdra's house under sūtaka, five thousand times for a Vaiśya's house, and three thousand times for a Kṣatriya's house.
items.note: Gāyatrī: the most sacred Vedic verse, recited in daily prayer and as a purifier.

items.text:
ब्राह्मणस्य यदा भुङ्क्ते द्वे सहस्रे तु दापयेत् ।
अथवा वामदैव्येन साम्नैवैकेन शुध्यति ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
brāhmaṇasya yadā bhuṅkte dve sahasre tu dāpayet |
athavā vāmadaivyena sāmnaivaikena śudhyati || 18 ||
items.en: When he eats in a Brahmin's house under impurity, he should recite it two thousand times. Or he is purified by singing just the one Vāmadevya chant.
items.note: Vāmadevya: a particular chant (sāman) of the Sāma Veda.

items.text:
शुष्कान्नं गोरसं स्नेहं शूद्रवेश्मन आगतम् ।
पक्वं विप्रगृहे भुक्तं भोज्यं तन्मनुरब्रवीत् ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
śuṣkānnaṃ gorasaṃ snehaṃ śūdraveśmana āgatam |
pakvaṃ vipragṛhe bhuktaṃ bhojyaṃ tanmanurabravīt || 19 ||
items.en: Uncooked grain, milk products and fat brought from a Śūdra's house, if cooked in a Brahmin's house, may be eaten. Manu said this.

items.text:
आपत्कालेषु विप्रेण भुक्तं शूद्रगृहे यदि ।
मनस्तापेन शुध्येत द्रुपदां वा जपेच्छतम् ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
āpatkāleṣu vipreṇa bhuktaṃ śūdragṛhe yadi |
manastāpena śudhyeta drupadāṃ vā japecchatam || 20 ||
items.en: If a Brahmin eats in a Śūdra's house in a time of distress, he is purified by sincere regret, or he may recite the Drupadā verse a hundred times.
items.note: Drupadā: a Vedic verse used for purification.

items.text:
दासनापितगोपाल कुलमित्रार्धसीलिणः ।
एते शूद्रेषु भोज्यान्ना यश्चात्मानं निवेदयेत् ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
dāsanāpitagopāla kulamitrārdhasīliṇaḥ |
ete śūdreṣu bhojyānnā yaścātmānaṃ nivedayet || 21 ||
items.en: A servant, a barber, a cowherd, a family friend, and a share-cropper — among Śūdras, the food of these may be eaten, and also of one who offers himself into service.

items.text:
शूद्रकन्यासमुत्पन्नो ब्राह्मणेन तु संस्कृतः ।
संस्कारात्तु भवेद्दासः असंस्कारात्तु नापितः ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
śūdrakanyāsamutpanno brāhmaṇena tu saṃskṛtaḥ |
saṃskārāttu bhaveddāsaḥ asaṃskārāttu nāpitaḥ || 22 ||
items.en: A son born to a Brahmin from a Śūdra girl: if he has received the sacraments he becomes a dāsa (servant); if not, he becomes a nāpita (barber).

items.text:
क्षत्रियाच्छूद्रकन्यायां समुत्पन्नस्तु यः सुतः ।
स गोपाल इति ज्ञेयो भोज्यो विप्रैर्न संशयः ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
kṣatriyācchūdrakanyāyāṃ samutpannastu yaḥ sutaḥ |
sa gopāla iti jñeyo bhojyo viprairna saṃśayaḥ || 23 ||
items.en: The son born to a Kṣatriya from a Śūdra girl is known as a gopāla (cowherd). Brahmins may eat his food, there is no doubt.

items.text:
वैश्यकन्यासमुत्पन्नो ब्राह्मणेन तु संस्कृतः ।
स ह्यार्धिक इति ज्ञेयो भोज्यो विप्रैर्न संशयः ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
vaiśyakanyāsamutpanno brāhmaṇena tu saṃskṛtaḥ |
sa hyārdhika iti jñeyo bhojyo viprairna saṃśayaḥ || 24 ||
items.en: One born from a Vaiśya girl to a Brahmin and given the sacraments is known as an ārdhika (share-cropper). Brahmins may eat his food, there is no doubt.

items.text:
भाण्डस्थितं अभोज्येषु जलं दधि घृतं पयः ।
अकामतस्तु यो भुङ्क्ते प्रायश्चित्तं कथं भवेत् ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
bhāṇḍasthitaṃ abhojyeṣu jalaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ payaḥ |
akāmatastu yo bhuṅkte prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 25 ||
items.en: If a person, without meaning to, consumes water, curd, ghee or milk kept in the vessel of someone whose food must not be eaten, what is the penance?

items.text:
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रो वा उपसर्पति ।
ब्रह्मकूर्चोपवासेन याज्यवर्णस्य निष्कृतिः ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā upasarpati |
brahmakūrcopavāsena yājyavarṇasya niṣkṛtiḥ || 26 ||
items.en: Whether a Brahmin, Kṣatriya, Vaiśya or Śūdra does this, the atonement is a fast with brahmakūrca, according to the person's varṇa.
items.note: The phrase 'yājyavarṇasya' is unclear; this is a best reading.

items.text:
शूद्राणां नोपवासः स्याच्छूद्रो दानेन शुध्यति ।
ब्रह्मकूर्चं अहोरात्रं श्वपाकं अपि शोधयेत् ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
śūdrāṇāṃ nopavāsaḥ syācchūdro dānena śudhyati |
brahmakūrcaṃ ahorātraṃ śvapākaṃ api śodhayet || 27 ||
items.en: Śūdras should not fast; a Śūdra is purified by giving gifts. Brahmakūrca taken after a day and night of fasting purifies even a dog-eater.

items.text:
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् ।
निर्दिष्टं पञ्चगव्यं तु पवित्रं पापशोधनं ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam |
nirdiṣṭaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tu pavitraṃ pāpaśodhanaṃ || 28 ||
items.en: Cow urine, cow dung, milk, curd, ghee and water with kuśa grass — this is called pañcagavya. It is holy and removes sin.

items.text:
गोमूत्रं कृष्णवर्णायाः श्वेतायाश्चैव गोमयम् ।
पयश्च ताम्रवर्णाया रक्ताया गृह्यते दधि ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
gomūtraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścaiva gomayam |
payaśca tāmravarṇāyā raktāyā gṛhyate dadhi || 29 ||
items.en: The cow urine is taken from a black cow, the dung from a white cow, the milk from a copper-coloured cow, and the curd from a red cow.

items.text:
कपिलाया घृतं ग्राह्यं सर्वं कापिलं एव वा ।
मूत्रं एकपलं दद्यादङ्गुष्ठार्धं तु गोमयं ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ sarvaṃ kāpilaṃ eva vā |
mūtraṃ ekapalaṃ dadyādaṅguṣṭhārdhaṃ tu gomayaṃ || 30 ||
items.en: The ghee should be from a tawny cow, or all of it may be taken from a tawny cow. One should use one pala of urine and dung the size of half a thumb.
items.note: pala: an old unit of weight (roughly 40-50 grams).

items.text:
क्षीरं सप्तपलं दद्याद्दधि त्रिपलं उच्यते ।
घृतं एकपलं दद्यात्पलं एकं कुशोदकम् ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
kṣīraṃ saptapalaṃ dadyāddadhi tripalaṃ ucyate |
ghṛtaṃ ekapalaṃ dadyātpalaṃ ekaṃ kuśodakam || 31 ||
items.en: Milk should be seven palas, curd is said to be three palas, ghee one pala, and kuśa water one pala.

items.text:
गायत्र्यादाय गोमूत्रं गन्धद्वारेति गोमयम् ।
आप्यायस्वेति च क्षीरं दधिक्राव्णस्तथा दधि ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
gāyatryādāya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayam |
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇastathā dadhi || 32 ||
items.en: One takes the urine with the Gāyatrī, the dung with the verse 'gandhadvārā', the milk with 'āpyāyasva', and the curd with 'dadhikrāvṇo'.
items.note: These are the opening words of Vedic verses recited while taking each item.

items.text:
तेजोऽसि शुक्रं इत्याज्यं देवस्य त्वा कुशोदकम् ।
पञ्चगव्यं ऋचा पूतं स्थापयेदग्निसंनिधौ ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
tejo'si śukraṃ ityājyaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakam |
pañcagavyaṃ ṛcā pūtaṃ sthāpayedagnisaṃnidhau || 33 ||
items.en: The ghee with 'tejo 'si śukram', the kuśa water with 'devasya tvā'. The pañcagavya, purified by these verses, should be placed near the fire.

items.text:
आपोहिष्ठेति चालोड्य मानस्तोकेति मन्त्रयेत् ।
सप्तावरास्तु ये दर्भा अछिन्नाग्राः शुकत्विषः ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
āpohiṣṭheti cāloḍya mānastoketi mantrayet |
saptāvarāstu ye darbhā achinnāgrāḥ śukatviṣaḥ || 34 ||
items.en: One should stir it with 'āpo hi ṣṭhā' and consecrate it with 'mā nas toke'. Blades of darbha grass, at least seven, with uncut tips and green as a parrot —

items.text:
एतैरुद्धृत्य होतव्यं पञ्चगव्यं यथाविधि ।
इरावती इदं विष्णुर्मानस्तोकेति शंवती ॥ ३५ ॥
items.tr:
etairuddhṛtya hotavyaṃ pañcagavyaṃ yathāvidhi |
irāvatī idaṃ viṣṇurmānastoketi śaṃvatī || 35 ||
items.en: … with these one should lift and offer the pañcagavya into the fire according to the rule, with the verses 'irāvatī', 'idaṃ viṣṇur', 'mā nas toke' and 'śaṃvatī'.

items.text:
एताभिश्चैव होतव्यं हुतशेषं पिबेद्द्विजः ।
आलोड्य प्रणवेनैव निर्मन्थ्य प्रणवेन तु ॥ ३६ ॥
items.tr:
etābhiścaiva hotavyaṃ hutaśeṣaṃ pibeddvijaḥ |
āloḍya praṇavenaiva nirmanthya praṇavena tu || 36 ||
items.en: With these verses one should offer it, and the twice-born should drink what is left after the offering. He should stir it with Om and mix it with Om,
items.note: Om (praṇava): the sacred syllable.

items.text:
उद्धृत्य प्रणवेनैव पिबेच्च प्रणवेन तु ।
यत्त्वस्थिगतं पापं देहे तिष्ठति देहिनाम् ॥ ३७ ॥
items.tr:
uddhṛtya praṇavenaiva pibecca praṇavena tu |
yattvasthigataṃ pāpaṃ dehe tiṣṭhati dehinām || 37 ||
items.en: … lift it with Om, and drink it with Om. Whatever sin stays in the body of living beings, even down in the bones,

items.text:
ब्रह्मकूर्चो दहेत्सर्वं प्रदीप्ताग्निरिवेन्धनम् ।
पवित्रं त्रिषु लोकेषु देवताभिरधिष्ठितं ॥ ३८ ॥
items.tr:
brahmakūrco dahetsarvaṃ pradīptāgnirivendhanam |
pavitraṃ triṣu lokeṣu devatābhiradhiṣṭhitaṃ || 38 ||
items.en: … the brahmakūrca burns it all, as a blazing fire burns fuel. It is holy in the three worlds and the gods dwell in it.

items.text:
वरुणश्चैव गोमूत्रे गोमये हव्यवाहनः ।
दध्नि वायुः समुद्दिष्टः सोमः क्षीरे घृते रविः ॥ ३९ ॥
items.tr:
varuṇaścaiva gomūtre gomaye havyavāhanaḥ |
dadhni vāyuḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ somaḥ kṣīre ghṛte raviḥ || 39 ||
items.en: Varuṇa is in the cow urine, Agni in the dung, Vāyu in the curd, Soma in the milk, and the Sun in the ghee.
items.note: These are Vedic gods: Varuṇa (waters), Agni (fire), Vāyu (wind), Soma (moon).

items.text:
पिबतः पतितं तोयं भाजने मुखनिःसृतम् ।
अपेयं तद्विजानीयात्पीत्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत् ॥ ४० ॥
items.tr:
pibataḥ patitaṃ toyaṃ bhājane mukhaniḥsṛtam |
apeyaṃ tadvijānīyātpītvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret || 40 ||
items.en: Water that falls back from the mouth into the vessel while one is drinking — know that it is not fit to drink. If one drinks it, one should perform the Cāndrāyaṇa.

items.text:
कूपे च पतितं दृष्ट्वा श्वसृगालौ च मर्कटम् ।
अस्थिचर्मादि पतितं पीत्वामेध्या अपो द्विजः ॥ ४१ ॥
items.tr:
kūpe ca patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śvasṛgālau ca markaṭam |
asthicarmādi patitaṃ pītvāmedhyā apo dvijaḥ || 41 ||
items.en: If a twice-born drinks impure water from a well after seeing that a dog, jackal or monkey has fallen into it, or bones, skin and the like have fallen in,
items.note: This sentence runs through 11.41-11.44.

items.text:
नारं तु कुणपं काकं विड्वराहखरोष्ट्रकम् ।
गावयं सौप्रतीकं च मायूरं खाड्गकं तथा ॥ ४२ ॥
items.tr:
nāraṃ tu kuṇapaṃ kākaṃ viḍvarāhakharoṣṭrakam |
gāvayaṃ saupratīkaṃ ca māyūraṃ khāḍgakaṃ tathā || 42 ||
items.en: … or a human corpse, a crow, a village pig, a donkey, a camel, a gavaya, an elephant, a peacock, a rhinoceros,
items.note: gavaya: a kind of wild ox.

items.text:
वैयाघ्रं आर्क्षं सैंहं वा कूपे यदि निमज्जति ।
तटाकस्याथ दुष्टस्य पीतं स्यादुदकं यदि ॥ ४३ ॥
items.tr:
vaiyāghraṃ ārkṣaṃ saiṃhaṃ vā kūpe yadi nimajjati |
taṭākasyātha duṣṭasya pītaṃ syādudakaṃ yadi || 43 ||
items.en: … a tiger, a bear or a lion has sunk in the well, or if he has drunk water from a polluted pond,

items.text:
प्रायश्चित्तं भवेत्पुंसः क्रमेणैतेन सर्वशः ।
विप्रः शुध्येत्त्रिरात्रेण क्षत्रियस्तु दिनद्वयात् ॥ ४४ ॥
items.tr:
prāyaścittaṃ bhavetpuṃsaḥ krameṇaitena sarvaśaḥ |
vipraḥ śudhyettrirātreṇa kṣatriyastu dinadvayāt || 44 ||
items.en: … the penance for the man in all these cases is in this order: a Brahmin is purified in three nights, a Kṣatriya in two days,

items.text:
एकाहेन तु वैश्यस्तु शूद्रो नक्तेन शुध्यति ।
परपाकनिवृत्तस्य परपाकरतस्य च ॥ ४५ ॥
items.tr:
ekāhena tu vaiśyastu śūdro naktena śudhyati |
parapākanivṛttasya parapākaratasya ca || 45 ||
items.en: … a Vaiśya in one day, and a Śūdra by eating only at night. Of one who has given up others' cooking, and of one who is fond of others' cooking,

items.text:
अपचस्य च भुक्त्वान्नं द्विजश्चान्द्रायणं चरेत् ।
अपचस्य च यद्दानं दातुश्चास्य कुतः फलम् ॥ ४६ ॥
items.tr:
apacasya ca bhuktvānnaṃ dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |
apacasya ca yaddānaṃ dātuścāsya kutaḥ phalam || 46 ||
items.en: … and of one who does not cook — if a twice-born eats the food of these, he should perform the Cāndrāyaṇa. What reward can there be for the giver of a gift to one who does not cook?
items.note: 'One who does not cook' (apaca) is defined in 11.49-11.50.

items.text:
दाता प्रतिग्रहीता च तौ द्वौ निरयगामिनौ ।
गृहीत्वाग्निं समारोप्य पञ्चयज्ञान्न निर्वपेत् ॥ ४७ ॥
items.tr:
dātā pratigrahītā ca tau dvau nirayagāminau |
gṛhītvāgniṃ samāropya pañcayajñānna nirvapet || 47 ||
items.en: Both the giver and the receiver go to hell. One who, having taken and set up the sacred fire, does not perform the five great sacrifices —
items.note: The five great sacrifices: daily offerings to the Veda, ancestors, gods, beings and guests. The text says 'does not perform'; the sense of 11.47-11.48 is unclear and the reading may be faulty.

items.text:
परपाकनिवृत्तोऽसौ मुनिभिः परिकीर्तितः ।
पञ्चयज्ञान्स्वयं कृत्वा परान्नेनोपजीवति ॥ ४८ ॥
items.tr:
parapākanivṛtto'sau munibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
pañcayajñānsvayaṃ kṛtvā parānnenopajīvati || 48 ||
items.en: … he is called by the sages 'one who has given up others' cooking'. One who performs the five sacrifices himself but lives on other people's food,
items.note: The definition here is unclear; this is a best reading.

items.text:
सततं प्रातरुत्थाय परपाकरतस्तु सः ।
गृहस्थधर्मा यो विप्रो ददाति परिवर्जितः ॥ ४९ ॥
items.tr:
satataṃ prātarutthāya parapākaratastu saḥ |
gṛhasthadharmā yo vipro dadāti parivarjitaḥ || 49 ||
items.en: … rising early every day for it, is 'one fond of others' cooking'. A Brahmin who follows the householder's life but gives nothing,

items.text:
ऋषिभिर्धर्मतत्त्वज्ञैरपचः परिकीर्तितः ।
युगे युगे तु ये धर्मास्तेषु तेषु च ये द्विजाः ॥ ५० ॥
items.tr:
ṛṣibhirdharmatattvajñairapacaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
yuge yuge tu ye dharmāsteṣu teṣu ca ye dvijāḥ || 50 ||
items.en: … is called 'one who does not cook' by the sages who know the truth of dharma. In each age there are different dharmas, and the twice-born of each age —

items.text:
तेषां निन्दा न कर्तव्या युगरूपा हि ते द्विजाः ।
हुंकारं ब्राह्मणस्योक्त्वा त्वंकारं च गरीयसः ॥ ५१ ॥
items.tr:
teṣāṃ nindā na kartavyā yugarūpā hi te dvijāḥ |
huṃkāraṃ brāhmaṇasyoktvā tvaṃkāraṃ ca garīyasaḥ || 51 ||
items.en: … should not be blamed, because those twice-born are shaped by their age. If one says 'hum' (with contempt) to a Brahmin, or addresses an elder with the rude 'you',

items.text:
स्नात्वा तिष्ठन्नहः शेषं अभिवाद्य प्रसादयेत् ।
ताडयित्वा तृणेनापि कण्ठे बद्ध्वापि वाससा ॥ ५२ ॥
items.tr:
snātvā tiṣṭhannahaḥ śeṣaṃ abhivādya prasādayet |
tāḍayitvā tṛṇenāpi kaṇṭhe baddhvāpi vāsasā || 52 ||
items.en: … he should bathe, fast for the rest of the day, bow to him and win his favour. If one strikes him even with a blade of grass, or ties him by the neck with a cloth,

items.text:
विवादेनापि निर्जित्य प्रणिपत्य प्रसादयेत् ।
अवगूर्य त्वहोरात्रं त्रिरात्रं क्षितिपातने ॥ ५३ ॥
items.tr:
vivādenāpi nirjitya praṇipatya prasādayet |
avagūrya tvahorātraṃ trirātraṃ kṣitipātane || 53 ||
items.en: … or defeats him in argument, one should bow down and win his favour. For raising a weapon against him, a fast of a day and night; for throwing him to the ground, three nights;

items.text:
अतिकृच्छ्रं च रुधिरे कृच्छ्रोऽभ्यन्तरशोणिते ।
नवाहं अतिकृच्छ्री स्यात्पाणिपूरान्नभोजनः ॥ ५४ ॥
items.tr:
atikṛcchraṃ ca rudhire kṛcchro'bhyantaraśoṇite |
navāhaṃ atikṛcchrī syātpāṇipūrānnabhojanaḥ || 54 ||
items.en: … if blood is drawn, the Atikṛcchra; if there is bleeding inside, the Kṛcchra. In the Atikṛcchra one eats only a handful of food for nine days,
items.note: Atikṛcchra: a harder form of the Kṛcchra penance.

items.text:
त्रिरात्रं उपवासी स्यादतिकृच्छ्रः स उच्यते ।
सर्वेषां एव पापानां संकरे समुपस्थिते ॥ ५५ ॥
items.tr:
trirātraṃ upavāsī syādatikṛcchraḥ sa ucyate |
sarveṣāṃ eva pāpānāṃ saṃkare samupasthite || 55 ||
items.en: … and fasts for three nights; this is called the Atikṛcchra. When a mixture of all kinds of sins is present,

items.text: दशसाहस्रं अभ्यस्ता गायत्री शोधनं परम् ॥ ५६ ॥
items.tr: daśasāhasraṃ abhyastā gāyatrī śodhanaṃ param || 56 ||
items.en: … reciting the Gāyatrī ten thousand times is the highest purification.
